title: A NEAR MISS WHIZZES PAST
why: His order of 2026-10-12: improve the sound and give every action that has no sound of its own a distinct one. An enemy round that missed you narrowly flew past in silence; enemy fire was heard only at the gun. Now a round that passes within a stride of you without hitting whizzes past once, on the side it went by: a short rush of noise falling in pitch with a tiny snap at the front, the crack of a round going past your head. It rides the HUD sound, so a loud fight never buries it, and a shotgun blast past you is one whizz, not eight. This build also adds the small kit the next new noises are built from. Sound only: nothing in the raid changes.
now: An enemy round that just misses you now whizzes past on the side it went by.
